what: The standard deviations Bozo's Worst Beat lever divides by. Full-game values per sport; period legs scale them.
source: dawg-bot-worker.js ROYALE_SD (the grader) and bozo.html SPORTS (the simulator). The grader's table is authoritative; a test pins this file to it.
period_rule: SD(period) = SD(game) x sqrt(period_fraction). beatBasis = "scaled-sd". A model, not a measurement: it assumes segment variance adds independently. Pending Phase 4.3 calibration per (sport, period, market).
props_and_other: max(|line| x 0.55, 1) — an openly placeholder guess, flagged everywhere.
known_gap: bozo.html SPORTS carries cfb sd 16 / tot 14 while the grader carries 16.5 / 13.0; the simulator's Worst Beat therefore differs slightly from the grader's for CFB full-game legs. Recorded, not yet reconciled.
